description: Electric Outages is a dataset listed in City of Roseville open data portal (data.roseville.ca.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Roseville. Coverage: Roseville, California. The portal files it under the category Electric. Its tags are outages, electric, power. The table has 23 columns. Attribution on the portal: Electric. The portal shows 2026-01-14 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-roseville-ca-us-portal.
